name: AboutDialog
description: A Material Design dialog that shows application information such as name, version, and legalese. Typically used for an “About” section in apps.
how_to_use:
showAboutDialog(
  context: context,
  applicationName: 'My Flutter App',
  applicationVersion: '1.0.0',
  applicationLegalese: '© 2025 My Company',
  applicationIcon: FlutterLogo(size: 48),
);

properties.name: applicationName
properties.description: The name of the application to display in the dialog.
properties.default_value: null (defaults to the app's title from MaterialApp if provided)

properties.name: applicationVersion
properties.description: The version of the application.

properties.name: applicationIcon
properties.description: An optional widget to display as the application icon at the top of the dialog.

properties.name: applicationLegalese
properties.description: Optional legal text to display, such as copyright information.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Optional widgets to display between the version/legalese and the close button.

name: AboutListTile
description: A convenience ListTile that opens an About dialog when tapped. It’s a quick way to include an app information section inside a Drawer or Settings screen.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Leading widget shown before the title (usually an Icon).

properties.name: child
properties.description: Custom widget for the tile’s title. If null, `applicationName` or a default text is used.

properties.name: applicationName
properties.description: The name of the application displayed in the About dialog.
properties.default_value: null (defaults to the MaterialApp title if available)

properties.name: applicationVersion
properties.description: The version of the application displayed in the About dialog.

properties.name: applicationIcon
properties.description: Widget displayed as the application icon inside the About dialog.

properties.name: applicationLegalese
properties.description: Optional legal text such as copyright or license info.

properties.name: aboutBoxChildren
properties.description: Additional widgets to display in the About dialog below the version/legalese.

properties.name: dense
properties.description: Whether this list tile is part of a vertically dense list.

properties.name: onTap
properties.description: Callback when the tile is tapped. Defaults to showing the About dialog.

name: AbsorbPointer
description: A widget that prevents its subtree from receiving pointer events. It still participates in layout and painting but absorbs any touches, gestures, or pointer interactions.

properties.name: absorbing
properties.description: Whether to absorb (block) pointer events. If true, the child cannot be interacted with.

properties.name: ignoringSemantics
properties.description: Whether to ignore the semantics of the child for accessibility. Useful when disabling interactions but keeping or removing semantics.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree that will be prevented from receiving pointer events.

name: AlertDialog
description: A Material Design alert dialog. It typically contains a title, content, and a set of actions. Used to notify the user of situations that require acknowledgment or a decision.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The primary content of the dialog displayed in the title area.
properties.possible_values: Any widget, typically a Text widget.

properties.name: titlePadding
properties.description: Padding around the title.

properties.name: titleTextStyle
properties.description: Text style of the title.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The main content of the dialog, typically a Text or Column widget.

properties.name: contentPadding
properties.description: Padding around the content.

properties.name: contentTextStyle
properties.description: Text style for the content area.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The set of actions at the bottom of the dialog (e.g., buttons).
properties.possible_values: List of widgets, typically TextButton or ElevatedButton.

properties.name: actionsPadding
properties.description: Padding around the actions area.

properties.name: actionsOverflowDirection
properties.description: The direction in which action buttons should overflow.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the dialog.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the dialog's material.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Shape of the dialog's border.

properties.name: scrollable
properties.description: Whether the content is scrollable if it overflows.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip content if it overflows the dialog's boundary.

properties.name: insetPadding
properties.description: Padding applied to the dialog to prevent it from growing too large.

properties.name: semanticLabel
properties.description: Semantic label for accessibility.

name: Align
description: A widget that aligns its child within itself and optionally sizes itself based on the child's size.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: Defines how the child is aligned within the parent.
properties.possible_values: Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.topCenter, Alignment.topRight, Alignment.centerLeft, Alignment.center, Alignment.centerRight, Alignment.bottomLeft, Alignment.bottomCenter, Alignment.bottomRight, Alignment(x, y)

properties.name: widthFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the width of the Align widget to be this factor times the child's width.

properties.name: heightFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the height of the Align widget to be this factor times the child's height.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree to be aligned.

name: AnimatedAlign
description: A widget that automatically transitions its child's position over a given duration whenever the alignment changes. Useful for smooth animations when changing alignment.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment of the child within the parent. Changes to this value are animated.
properties.possible_values: Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.topCenter, Alignment.topRight, Alignment.centerLeft, Alignment.center, Alignment.centerRight, Alignment.bottomLeft, Alignment.bottomCenter, Alignment.bottomRight, Alignment(x, y)

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time the animation should last when alignment changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when changing alignment.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeIn, Curves.easeOut

properties.name: widthFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the width of the AnimatedAlign to this factor times the child's width.

properties.name: heightFactor
properties.description: If non-null, sets the height of the AnimatedAlign to this factor times the child's height.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree to animate.

name: AnimatedBuilder
description: A widget that rebuilds whenever the given animation changes. It is useful for creating custom animations without creating a separate StatefulWidget.

properties.name: animation
properties.description: The animation (usually an AnimationController or Animation) to listen to. The builder is called whenever this animation updates.
properties.possible_values: Any object that implements Listenable, e.g., AnimationController or Animation<double>

properties.name: builder
properties.description: Called whenever the animation changes. Must return a widget that is part of the widget tree.

properties.name: child
properties.description: Optional child widget that does not depend on the animation and can be passed to the builder to avoid rebuilding it every frame.

name: AnimatedContainer
description: A container that automatically animates changes to its properties over a given duration and curve. Useful for creating implicit animations without a StatefulWidget.
how_to_use:
AnimatedContainer(
  width: _isExpanded ? 200 : 100,
  height: _isExpanded ? 200 : 100,
  color: _isExpanded ? Colors.blue : Colors.red,
  alignment: _isExpanded ? Alignment.center : Alignment.topLeft,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
  child: const Text('Animated Container'),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: How to align the child within the container.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Empty space inside the container around the child.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Background color of the container.

properties.name: decoration
properties.description: A decoration to paint behind the child. Cannot be specified if color is non-null.

properties.name: foregroundDecoration
properties.description: A decoration to paint in front of the child.

properties.name: width
properties.description: The width of the container.

properties.name: height
properties.description: The height of the container.

properties.name: constraints
properties.description: Additional constraints to apply to the container.

properties.name: margin
properties.description: Empty space around the container.

properties.name: transform
properties.description: A transformation to apply before painting the container.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate changes to properties.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating changes.

name: AnimatedCrossFade
description: A widget that cross-fades between two children and animates their size over a given duration. Useful for smoothly transitioning between two widgets.
how_to_use:
AnimatedCrossFade(
  firstChild: Container(
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    color: Colors.blue,
    child: Center(child: Text('First')),
  ),
  secondChild: Container(
    width: 150,
    height: 150,
    color: Colors.red,
    child: Center(child: Text('Second')),
  ),
  crossFadeState: _showFirst ? CrossFadeState.showFirst : CrossFadeState.showSecond,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  firstCurve: Curves.easeIn,
  secondCurve: Curves.easeOut,
);

properties.name: firstChild
properties.description: The first widget to display in the cross-fade.

properties.name: secondChild
properties.description: The second widget to display in the cross-fade.

properties.name: crossFadeState
properties.description: Determines which child is shown.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate the cross-fade.

properties.name: reverseDuration
properties.description: The duration of the reverse animation. If null, uses `duration`.

properties.name: sizeCurve
properties.description: The curve to apply to the size animation during the cross-fade.

properties.name: firstCurve
properties.description: The curve to apply to the first child’s opacity animation.

properties.name: secondCurve
properties.description: The curve to apply to the second child’s opacity animation.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment of the children within the parent during the cross-fade.
properties.possible_values: Any Alignment, e.g., Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.center, etc.

name: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in the default text style (TextStyle) of its child over a given duration. Useful for smooth text style transitions without a StatefulWidget.
how_to_use:
AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(
  style: _isBold
      ? TextStyle(fontSize: 24, color: Colors.blue, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)
      : TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: Colors.black, fontWeight: FontWeight.normal),
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
  child: const Text('Animated Text Style'),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose text style will be animated.

properties.name: style
properties.description: The target text style to animate to.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate the text style changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating the text style changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut

properties.name: textAlign
properties.description: How the text should be aligned horizontally within its bounds.
properties.possible_values: start, end, center, justify, left, right

properties.name: softWrap
properties.description: Whether the text should break at soft line breaks.

properties.name: overflow
properties.description: How visual overflow should be handled.

properties.name: maxLines
properties.description: The maximum number of lines for the text.

name: AnimatedIcon
description: A widget that displays an animated icon that can be controlled via an AnimationController. Useful for animated transitions between icon states.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: The type of animated icon to display. This defines the animation between two icon states.
properties.possible_values: Any AnimatedIcons built-in icons, e.g., AnimatedIcons.menu_close, AnimatedIcons.play_pause, AnimatedIcons.add_event, etc.

properties.name: progress
properties.description: Controls the animation of the icon. The value should typically be between 0.0 and 1.0.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the icon in logical pixels.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color to use when painting the icon.

properties.name: semanticLabel
properties.description: Text description for accessibility.

properties.name: textDirection
properties.description: The text direction to use for rendering icons that depend on text direction (like arrow animations).

name: AnimatedList
description: A scrollable list of widgets that animates items when they are inserted or removed. Useful for dynamic lists where items can appear or disappear with smooth animations.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional key to uniquely identify the AnimatedList.

properties.name: initialItemCount
properties.description: The number of items the list starts with.

properties.name: itemBuilder
properties.description: Called to build each child in the list. Provides the index and an animation for insertion/removal.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Controls the scroll offset of the list.

properties.name: scrollDirection
properties.description: The axis along which the list scrolls.

properties.name: reverse
properties.description: Whether the list scrolls in the opposite direction.

properties.name: physics
properties.description: How the list should respond to user scrolling.

properties.name: shrinkWrap
properties.description: Whether the list should occupy only the space it needs.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Padding around the list.

name: AnimatedModalBarrier
description: A widget that prevents user interaction with widgets behind it and animates the barrier color over a given animation. Often used in modal routes to block touches and provide visual feedback.

properties.name: color
properties.description: An animation that defines the color of the modal barrier. Changes in color are animated automatically.

properties.name: dismissible
properties.description: Whether tapping the barrier should dismiss the modal route.

properties.name: semanticsLabel
properties.description: Semantic label for accessibility.

name: AnimatedOpacity
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in opacity of its child over a given duration. Useful for fade-in and fade-out effects without using a StatefulWidget manually.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose opacity will be animated.

properties.name: opacity
properties.description: The target opacity value. 0.0 means fully transparent and 1.0 means fully opaque.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate opacity changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating the opacity changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut

name: AnimatedPadding
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in its padding over a given duration and curve. Useful for smoothly adjusting spacing around a child widget without a StatefulWidget.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose padding will be animated.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: The target padding around the child.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate padding changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating the padding changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut, Curves.bounceIn

name: AnimatedPhysicalModel
description: A widget that animates changes in a physical model’s properties such as color, elevation, shape, and shadow over a given duration. Useful for smooth Material-style animations.
how_to_use:
AnimatedPhysicalModel(
  child: Container(width: 100, height: 100, color: Colors.blue),
  color: _isSelected ? Colors.red : Colors.blue,
  elevation: _isSelected ? 10 : 2,
  shape: BoxShape.rectangle,
  shadowColor: Colors.black,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose physical model will be animated.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the physical model.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate at which to place this physical model. Higher elevation casts bigger shadows.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the box. Can be rectangle or circle.

properties.name: shadowColor
properties.description: The color of the shadow below the physical model.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the child if it overflows the bounds.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate changes to properties.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating property changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut

name: AnimatedPositioned
description: A widget that automatically animates changes to a child's position within a Stack over a given duration and curve. Useful for smooth repositioning without manual animation controllers.
how_to_use:
AnimatedPositioned(
  left: _isMoved ? 200 : 50,
  top: _isMoved ? 300 : 100,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
  child: Container(
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    color: Colors.blue,
  ),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose position will be animated.

properties.name: left
properties.description: The distance from the left edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: top
properties.description: The distance from the top edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: right
properties.description: The distance from the right edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: The distance from the bottom edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: width
properties.description: The width of the child. If null, the child’s intrinsic width is used.

properties.name: height
properties.description: The height of the child. If null, the child’s intrinsic height is used.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate changes to position and size.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating position and size changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut

name: AnimatedRotation
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in its rotation angle over a given duration and curve. Useful for smoothly rotating a child widget without manually using an AnimationController.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree to rotate.

properties.name: turns
properties.description: The number of complete rotations to apply to the child. 1.0 equals a full 360-degree rotation.
properties.possible_values: Any double, e.g., 0.5 for 180 degrees, 1.0 for 360 degrees

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment around which to rotate the child.
properties.possible_values: Any Alignment, e.g., Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.center, Alignment.bottomRight

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate rotation changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating rotation.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut

name: AnimatedSize
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in its child's size over a given duration and curve. Useful for smooth resizing of widgets without using an explicit AnimationController.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose size will be animated.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate changes in size.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating size changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut, Curves.bounceIn

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment of the child within the AnimatedSize widget during size changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Alignment, e.g., Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.center, Alignment.bottomRight

properties.name: vsync
properties.description: A TickerProvider for driving the animation. Typically, use `this` in a StatefulWidget that mixes in `TickerProviderStateMixin`.
properties.possible_values: Any TickerProvider, e.g., a StatefulWidget with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin

name: AnimatedSwitcher
description: A widget that automatically transitions from an old child to a new child using a fade, scale, slide, or custom transition. Useful for smooth swapping of widgets with animation.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display. When this changes, AnimatedSwitcher animates from the old child to the new child.
properties.possible_values: Any widget. Must provide a unique Key to differentiate between children.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate the transition between old and new children.

properties.name: transitionBuilder
properties.description: Defines how the old child transitions out and the new child transitions in.
properties.possible_values: Any function returning a Widget. Can use FadeTransition, ScaleTransition, SlideTransition, etc.

properties.name: layoutBuilder
properties.description: Defines how to lay out the new child and the outgoing children during the transition.

properties.name: reverseDuration
properties.description: The duration to use for the reverse animation when switching back to a previous child.

properties.name: switchInCurve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when the new child appears.

properties.name: switchOutCurve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when the old child disappears.

name: AppBar
description: A material design app bar that displays at the top of the screen. It typically contains a title, navigation icons, and action buttons.

properties.name: title
properties.description: A widget to display as the app bar's title, usually a Text widget.

properties.name: leading
properties.description: A widget displayed before the title, often an IconButton for navigation.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Widgets displayed after the title, typically IconButtons for actions.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the app bar.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the app bar, affecting the shadow size.

properties.name: centerTitle
properties.description: Whether the title should be centered. Defaults depend on platform.

properties.name: automaticallyImplyLeading
properties.description: Whether to automatically add a back button or menu button when appropriate.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: A widget displayed at the bottom of the app bar, usually a TabBar.

properties.name: toolbarHeight
properties.description: Height of the toolbar portion of the app bar.

name: AspectRatio
description: A widget that attempts to size the child to a specific aspect ratio (width divided by height). Useful for keeping images, videos, or other content proportional.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree that will be sized according to the aspect ratio.

properties.name: aspectRatio
properties.description: The ratio of the width to the height of the child.

name: BackdropFilter
description: A widget that applies a filter to the existing painted content beneath its child. Commonly used for blurring backgrounds behind dialogs, modals, or other widgets.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree. The filter is applied to the content behind this child.

properties.name: filter
properties.description: The filter to apply to the existing painted content beneath the child. Can be blur, color filter, etc.

properties.name: opaque
properties.description: Whether the filter layer is opaque. Setting true may improve performance if the filtered area is fully opaque.

name: Banner
description: A widget that displays a diagonal message (banner) across a corner of another widget. Useful for showing labels such as 'NEW', 'SALE', or 'DEBUG' on top of content.
how_to_use:
Banner(
  message: 'NEW',
  location: BannerLocation.topEnd,
  color: Colors.red,
  textStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
  child: Container(
    width: 200,
    height: 200,
    color: Colors.blue,
  ),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below the banner, which the banner will overlay.

properties.name: message
properties.description: The text to display on the banner.

properties.name: location
properties.description: The corner where the banner should appear.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the banner.

properties.name: textStyle
properties.description: The style to use for the banner message text.

properties.name: messageDirection
properties.description: The text direction of the message.

name: Baseline
description: A widget that positions its child according to a baseline. Useful for aligning text or other widgets with a specific baseline in layouts.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree to be positioned according to the baseline.

properties.name: baseline
properties.description: The offset in logical pixels from the top of the parent to place the child's baseline.

properties.name: baselineType
properties.description: The type of baseline to use for aligning the child. Usually alphabetic or ideographic.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: BottomNavigationBar
description: A widget that displays a navigation bar at the bottom of the screen, allowing the user to switch between different views or pages.

properties.name: items
properties.description: The widgets to display as the bottom navigation items.

properties.name: currentIndex
properties.description: The index of the currently selected item.

properties.name: onTap
properties.description: Called when an item is tapped, providing its index.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The color of the navigation bar background.

properties.name: selectedItemColor
properties.description: The color of the selected item.

properties.name: unselectedItemColor
properties.description: The color of the unselected items.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The layout behavior of the navigation bar. Fixed shows all items, shifting animates changes.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the navigation bar, affecting shadow size.

properties.name: showSelectedLabels
properties.description: Whether to show labels for selected items.

properties.name: showUnselectedLabels
properties.description: Whether to show labels for unselected items.

name: BottomSheet
description: A widget that slides up from the bottom of the screen to display additional content. It can be persistent (always visible) or modal (temporary and dismissible).

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget displayed inside the bottom sheet.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the bottom sheet, affecting the shadow size.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the bottom sheet.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the bottom sheet's material.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the shape boundaries.

properties.name: enableDrag
properties.description: Whether the bottom sheet can be dragged down to dismiss.

properties.name: isScrollControlled
properties.description: Whether the bottom sheet can take full screen height and respond to content scrolling.

name: Builder
description: A widget that allows you to obtain a BuildContext that is a descendant of the parent. Useful when you need a context that has access to an ancestor widget (like Scaffold or Theme) which isn’t available in the current context.

properties.name: builder
properties.description: The function that returns a widget tree, providing a BuildContext that is a descendant of the parent.
properties.possible_values: Any function that returns a Widget

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: Card
description: A material design card: a panel with slightly rounded corners and a shadow. Useful for grouping related information in a visually distinct container.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget displayed inside the card.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the card.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the card, affecting the size of the shadow.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the card's material, often a RoundedRectangleBorder.

properties.name: margin
properties.description: Empty space surrounding the card.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content of the card.

name: Center
description: A widget that centers its child within itself. Useful for aligning a single widget in the middle of the parent.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display at the center.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: Checkbox
description: A material design checkbox. Allows the user to select one or more options. Typically used in forms or settings.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Whether the checkbox is checked.
properties.possible_values: true, false, or null (if tristate is true)

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user taps the checkbox to change its state.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.description: The fill color of the checkbox when it is checked.

properties.name: checkColor
properties.description: The color of the check icon inside the checkbox.

properties.name: tristate
properties.description: Whether the checkbox can have three states: true, false, or null.

properties.name: materialTapTargetSize
properties.description: Configures the minimum size of the tap target.

properties.name: focusColor
properties.description: The color of the checkbox when it has keyboard focus.

properties.name: hoverColor
properties.description: The color of the checkbox when a pointer is hovering over it.

name: CheckboxListTile
description: A widget that combines a checkbox with a ListTile, allowing for a labeled checkbox with optional subtitle and secondary widget. Useful for forms, settings, and options lists.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The primary content of the list tile, usually a Text widget.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Additional content displayed below the title.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Whether the checkbox is checked.
properties.possible_values: true, false, or null (if tristate is true)

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user taps the checkbox to change its state.

properties.name: secondary
properties.description: A widget to display opposite the checkbox, often an icon or avatar.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.description: The color to use when the checkbox is checked.

properties.name: checkColor
properties.description: The color of the check icon inside the checkbox.

properties.name: tristate
properties.description: Whether the checkbox can have three states: true, false, or null.

properties.name: controlAffinity
properties.description: The position of the checkbox relative to the text.

properties.name: dense
properties.description: Whether this list tile is part of a vertically dense list.

name: Chip
description: A material design chip. A compact element that represents an attribute, text, or action. Useful for tags, categories, or user input.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The primary content of the chip, usually a Text widget.

properties.name: avatar
properties.description: A widget to display before the label, often a CircleAvatar.

properties.name: onDeleted
properties.description: Called when the delete icon is tapped. If null, the delete icon is not shown.

properties.name: deleteIcon
properties.description: The icon to display for deletion.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the chip.

properties.name: labelStyle
properties.description: The style to use for the label text.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Empty space around the chip's content.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the chip, often a RoundedRectangleBorder or StadiumBorder.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the chip's content if it overflows.

name: ChoiceChip
description: A material design chip that represents a single choice from a set. Useful for filter options, preferences, or selections.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The primary content of the chip, usually a Text widget.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Whether this chip is currently selected.

properties.name: onSelected
properties.description: Called when the chip is tapped, providing the new selected state.

properties.name: avatar
properties.description: A widget to display before the label, often a CircleAvatar.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The chip's background color when not selected.

properties.name: selectedColor
properties.description: The chip's background color when selected.

properties.name: labelStyle
properties.description: The style to use for the label text.

properties.name: labelPadding
properties.description: Empty space surrounding the label.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the chip, often a StadiumBorder or RoundedRectangleBorder.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the chip's content if it overflows.

name: CircleAvatar
description: A circular widget that typically represents a user profile picture. Can display an image, icon, or text inside a circle.

properties.name: child
properties.description: A widget to display inside the circle, usually Text or Icon.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the circle.

properties.name: foregroundColor
properties.description: The default color for text and icons within the avatar.

properties.name: radius
properties.description: The radius of the circle. If null, defaults to 20.0

properties.name: minRadius
properties.description: The minimum radius constraint for the circle.

properties.name: maxRadius
properties.description: The maximum radius constraint for the circle.

properties.name: backgroundImage
properties.description: An image to display inside the circle.

properties.name: onBackgroundImageError
properties.description: Callback when the background image fails to load.

properties.name: foregroundImage
properties.description: An image displayed over the background image.

properties.name: onForegroundImageError
properties.description: Callback when the foreground image fails to load.

name: CircularProgressIndicator
description: A material design circular progress indicator. Indicates that an operation is ongoing. Can be determinate (with a value) or indeterminate (spinning).

properties.name: value
properties.description: The progress value, from 0.0 to 1.0. If null, the indicator is indeterminate (spinning).
properties.possible_values: Any double between 0.0 and 1.0, or null

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The color of the circle track behind the progress indicator.

properties.name: valueColor
properties.description: The color of the progress indicator. Usually wrapped in an AlwaysStoppedAnimation for a fixed color.

properties.name: strokeWidth
properties.description: The thickness of the line used to draw the circle.

properties.name: semanticsLabel
properties.description: Optional semantic label for accessibility.

properties.name: semanticsValue
properties.description: Optional semantic value describing the current progress.

name: ClipOval
description: A widget that clips its child using an oval or circular shape. Useful for creating circular profile pictures, buttons, or custom shapes.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the oval clip.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the oval boundary.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: ClipPath
description: A widget that clips its child using a custom path. Useful for creating complex shapes, custom designs, or animations.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the custom path.

properties.name: clipper
properties.description: A custom clipper that defines the clipping path.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the custom path.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: ClipRect
description: A widget that clips its child using a rectangle. Useful for preventing child widgets from overflowing or for applying custom rectangular animations.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the rectangle clip.

properties.name: clipper
properties.description: A custom clipper that defines the clipping rectangle.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the rectangle boundary.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: ClipRRect
description: A widget that clips its child with a rounded rectangle. Useful for creating rounded corners for images, containers, or any rectangular widget.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the rounded rectangle clip.

properties.name: borderRadius
properties.description: The radius of the rounded corners.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content if it overflows the rounded rectangle boundary.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CloseButton
description: A material design close button. Typically used to close dialogs, pages, or other overlay widgets.

properties.name: onPressed
properties.description: Callback function called when the button is tapped. If null, the button is disabled.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color to use for the close icon.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: ColoredBox
description: A widget that paints its area with a specified color. Useful for adding solid color backgrounds without extra decoration.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color to paint.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the colored box.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: ColorFilter
description: A widget used to apply a color filter to a child widget. Commonly used with images to apply color effects such as tint, grayscale, or blending.

properties.name: colorFilter
properties.description: The color filter to apply to the child widget.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to which the color filter is applied.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: ConstrainedBox
description: A widget that imposes additional constraints on its child. Useful for limiting or forcing a child widget’s size.

properties.name: constraints
properties.description: The additional constraints to apply to the child widget.
properties.possible_values: BoxConstraints.tight(Size), BoxConstraints(minWidth, maxWidth, minHeight, maxHeight), etc.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the constrained box.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: Container
description: A versatile widget that combines common painting, positioning, and sizing widgets. Useful for layout, styling, and decoration of its child.
how_to_use:
Container(
  width: 200,
  height: 100,
  padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
  margin: EdgeInsets.all(8),
  decoration: BoxDecoration(
    color: Colors.blue,
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
    border: Border.all(color: Colors.black, width: 2),
  ),
  alignment: Alignment.center,
  child: Text('Hello Container', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget to display inside the container.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: Aligns the child within the container.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Empty space to inscribe inside the container, around the child.

properties.name: margin
properties.description: Empty space to surround the container itself.

properties.name: width
properties.description: The container's width.

properties.name: height
properties.description: The container's height.

properties.name: constraints
properties.description: Additional constraints to apply to the container.

properties.name: decoration
properties.description: Decorates the container, e.g., background color, border, border radius, gradient, or box shadow.

properties.name: foregroundDecoration
properties.description: Decoration drawn in front of the child.

properties.name: transform
properties.description: Applies a transformation before painting the container.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip content when it overflows the container.

properties.name: color
properties.description: A shortcut for background color if decoration is not specified.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: Column
description: A widget that arranges its children vertically. Useful for building vertical layouts with alignment and spacing control.

properties.name: children
properties.description: The widgets to display in a vertical array.

properties.name: mainAxisAlignment
properties.description: How the children should be placed along the vertical axis.
properties.possible_values: start, end, center, spaceBetween, spaceAround, spaceEvenly

properties.name: crossAxisAlignment
properties.description: How the children should be aligned horizontally within the column.

properties.name: mainAxisSize
properties.description: The size of the column along the main axis (vertical).

properties.name: textDirection
properties.description: The text direction for determining horizontal alignment.

properties.name: verticalDirection
properties.description: The vertical order in which children are painted.

properties.name: textBaseline
properties.description: The baseline to use for aligning text when crossAxisAlignment is baseline.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoActionSheetAction
description: An iOS-style action button used inside a CupertinoActionSheet. Typically represents a single action option like 'Delete', 'Share', or 'Edit'.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The content of the action button, typically a Text widget.

properties.name: onPressed
properties.description: Callback function executed when the action is pressed.

properties.name: isDefaultAction
properties.description: Whether this action is the default (highlighted) action.

properties.name: isDestructiveAction
properties.description: Whether this action indicates a destructive operation (e.g., delete).

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoActivityIndicator
description: An iOS-style activity indicator (spinner) that shows that an ongoing process is happening. Similar to the UIActivityIndicator in iOS.

properties.name: animating
properties.description: Controls whether the spinner is spinning. If false, the spinner is hidden.

properties.name: radius
properties.description: The radius of the spinner. Affects the size of the indicator.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color of the spinner. If null, defaults to CupertinoColors.activeGray.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoAlertDialog
description: An iOS-style alert dialog that informs the user about situations requiring acknowledgment. It can display a title, content, and a list of actions (buttons).

properties.name: title
properties.description: The primary content of the alert dialog displayed in a larger font at the top.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The message or main body of the alert dialog, displayed under the title.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The set of actions (buttons) displayed at the bottom of the dialog.
properties.possible_values: List of CupertinoDialogAction or custom widgets.

properties.name: scrollController
properties.description: Controller for scrolling the content if it overflows vertically.

properties.name: actionScrollController
properties.description: Controller for scrolling the actions section if actions overflow.

properties.name: insetAnimationDuration
properties.description: The duration of the dialog's inset animation.

properties.name: insetAnimationCurve
properties.description: The curve used for the inset animation.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoButton
description: An iOS-style button that responds to touches with a fade-in/out effect. It is commonly used to create tappable controls that match the Cupertino design language.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget inside the button, usually a Text or Icon.

properties.name: onPressed
properties.description: The callback function that is called when the button is tapped. If null, the button is disabled.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the button.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: The padding inside the button around the child.

properties.name: borderRadius
properties.description: The border radius of the button for rounded corners.

properties.name: minSize
properties.description: The minimum size of the button.

properties.name: pressedOpacity
properties.description: The opacity of the button when pressed.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment of the child within the button.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Internal padding for the button content.

properties.name: disabledColor
properties.description: The background color when the button is disabled (onPressed is null).

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for the widget.

name: CupertinoContextMenu
description: An iOS-style context menu that shows a full-screen preview when the user long-presses on the child widget. It can display additional menu actions in a pop-up sheet.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: The list of menu actions shown when the context menu is opened.
properties.possible_values: List of CupertinoContextMenuAction or custom widgets.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget that triggers the context menu when long-pressed.

properties.name: previewBuilder
properties.description: An optional builder to customize the preview animation. Provides the build context, animation progress, and the default preview child.

properties.name: enableHapticFeedback
properties.description: Determines whether to trigger haptic feedback when the menu is opened.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoDatePicker
description: An iOS-style date and time picker. It displays a scrollable wheel interface allowing users to select a date, time, or both.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: The type of picker to display.

properties.name: onDateTimeChanged
properties.description: Called whenever the user changes the selected date or time.

properties.name: initialDateTime
properties.description: The initial date and time displayed by the picker.

properties.name: minimumDate
properties.description: The earliest date that can be selected.

properties.name: maximumDate
properties.description: The latest date that can be selected.

properties.name: minuteInterval
properties.description: The granularity of the minute selection.

properties.name: use24hFormat
properties.description: Whether to use a 24-hour format for time mode.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the picker.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoPageRoute
description: An iOS-style page route that transitions between screens with a Cupertino (iOS) page animation. It provides a swipe-back gesture to pop the current route and uses the standard iOS navigation transition.

properties.name: builder
properties.description: The builder function to create the primary contents of the route.

properties.name: settings
properties.description: Configuration information for the route, such as name and arguments.

properties.name: fullscreenDialog
properties.description: Whether the page is displayed as a full-screen modal dialog.

properties.name: maintainState
properties.description: Whether the route should remain in memory when it is inactive.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The title of the route, used by iOS for the back button text of the previous page.

properties.name: allowSnapshotting
properties.description: Determines whether this route can be snapshotted for use in iOS transition animations.

name: CupertinoPicker
description: An iOS-style picker that displays its children widgets on a scrollable wheel. It allows users to select a single value from a list of options with a smooth, scrollable interface.

properties.name: itemExtent
properties.description: The height of each child item in the picker.

properties.name: onSelectedItemChanged
properties.description: Called when the user scrolls and selects a new item.

properties.name: children
properties.description: The list of widgets to display as selectable options.

properties.name: diameterRatio
properties.description: Controls the curvature of the wheel. A smaller value makes the wheel more curved.

properties.name: magnification
properties.description: The magnification factor applied to the currently selected item.

properties.name: squeeze
properties.description: The ratio of the item extent to the viewport height, affecting spacing between items.

properties.name: offAxisFraction
properties.description: How far the wheel is horizontally shifted, where 0 is centered.

properties.name: scrollController
properties.description: Controls the scroll position of the picker. Useful for setting the initial selected index.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the picker wheel.

properties.name: selectionOverlay
properties.description: A custom widget displayed over the currently selected item. By default, a translucent grey overlay is used.

properties.name: looping
properties.description: Whether the picker loops back to the beginning when reaching the end of the list.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoPopupSurface
description: An iOS-style popup surface that provides a rounded, translucent background for popups and modal views. It is typically used as the visual container for Cupertino-style popup elements.

properties.name: isSurfacePainted
properties.description: Determines whether the popup surface is painted with a translucent background and rounded corners.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget inside the popup surface.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoSearchTextField
description: An iOS-style search text field that provides a text input for search queries. It typically includes a clear button, a search icon, and supports placeholder text.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: The placeholder text displayed when the field is empty.

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user changes the text in the field.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a String.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Controls the text being edited. Useful for reading and modifying the text.

properties.name: autofocus
properties.description: Whether this text field should focus itself if nothing else is already focused.

properties.name: style
properties.description: The style to use for the text being edited.

properties.name: prefixIcon
properties.description: An optional widget to display at the start of the text field, typically an icon.

properties.name: suffixIcon
properties.description: An optional widget to display at the end of the text field, often a clear button.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the text field.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoSlidingSegmentedControl
description: An iOS-style segmented control where the selected segment slides smoothly between options. Useful for switching between views or modes in an app.

properties.name: children
properties.description: A map of segment index/keys to the widgets to display in each segment.
properties.possible_values: Any map of key-value pairs where keys are of type T and values are Widgets.

properties.name: groupValue
properties.description: The currently selected value. Should match one of the keys in children.
properties.possible_values: Any key from the children map or null.

properties.name: onValueChanged
properties.description: Called when the user selects a different segment. Provides the new selected key.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a value of type T.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: The padding around the whole segmented control.

properties.name: thumbColor
properties.description: The color of the sliding thumb that highlights the selected segment.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the control when unselected.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoSlider
description: An iOS-style slider that allows users to select a value from a continuous range. It can be customized with minimum, maximum, and divisions, and provides a smooth sliding animation.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The current value of the slider.
properties.possible_values: Any double within min and max.

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user changes the slider's value.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a double.

properties.name: min
properties.description: The minimum value the user can select.

properties.name: max
properties.description: The maximum value the user can select.

properties.name: divisions
properties.description: The number of discrete divisions. If null, the slider is continuous.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.description: The color of the portion of the slider that has been selected.

properties.name: thumbColor
properties.description: The color of the slider thumb.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoSlidingSegmentedControl
description: An iOS-style segmented control where the selected segment slides smoothly between options. Useful for switching between views or modes in an app.

properties.name: children
properties.description: A map of segment index/keys to the widgets to display in each segment.
properties.possible_values: Any map of key-value pairs where keys are of type T and values are Widgets.

properties.name: groupValue
properties.description: The currently selected value. Should match one of the keys in children.
properties.possible_values: Any key from the children map or null.

properties.name: onValueChanged
properties.description: Called when the user selects a different segment. Provides the new selected key.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a value of type T.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: The padding around the whole segmented control.

properties.name: thumbColor
properties.description: The color of the sliding thumb that highlights the selected segment.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the control when unselected.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoSwitch
description: An iOS-style switch that toggles between on/off states. Commonly used to represent boolean settings in an app.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Whether the switch is on (true) or off (false).

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user toggles the switch. Provides the new value.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a bool.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.description: The color of the switch when it is on.

properties.name: trackColor
properties.description: The color of the switch track when it is off.

properties.name: thumbColor
properties.description: The color of the switch thumb. If null, defaults to white.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoTabScaffold
description: An iOS-style scaffold that lays out the tab bar at the bottom and displays content for the selected tab. Commonly used for apps with multiple tabs.

properties.name: tabBar
properties.description: The tab bar displayed at the bottom of the scaffold.

properties.name: tabBuilder
properties.description: Builder function that returns the content widget for the selected tab index.
properties.possible_values: Any function that returns a Widget for a given tab index.

properties.name: backgroundColor
properties.description: The background color of the scaffold.

properties.name: resizeToAvoidBottomInset
properties.description: Whether the scaffold should resize when the keyboard appears.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Optional controller for managing the active tab programmatically.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.

name: CupertinoTextField
description: An iOS-style text field for inputting text. Supports placeholder text, controllers, focus, and styling options.

properties.name: controller
properties.description: Controls the text being edited. Useful for reading and modifying the text.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Text displayed when the field is empty.

properties.name: onChanged
properties.description: Called when the user changes the text.
properties.possible_values: Any function that takes a String.

properties.name: keyboardType
properties.description: The type of keyboard to use for editing the text.

properties.name: obscureText
properties.description: Whether to hide the text being entered, useful for passwords.

properties.name: prefix
properties.description: An optional widget to display before the text field (like an icon).

properties.name: suffix
properties.description: An optional widget to display after the text field (like a clear button).

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Padding inside the text field.

properties.name: decoration
properties.description: The decoration around the text field.

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
